Thanks for contributing a robot profile! Please fill in what applies and delete
the rest. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full field-by-field guide.
-->

## What is this PR?

- [ ] New profile (`profiles/<id>/`)
- [ ] Update to an existing profile
- [ ] `planned` stub → full profile (adding buses/actuators/calibration/etc.)
- [ ] Schema / tooling change (`schema/`, `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/`)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Profile checklist (skip if this isn't a profile change)

- [ ] `id` matches the directory name, `^[a-z0-9_]+$`, and doesn't collide with an
      existing id or alias
- [ ] `profile.json` validates against `schema/robot-profile-v2.schema.json`
      (`python scripts/validate.py` passes locally)
- [ ] `support_status` is accurate:
  - `verified_hw` — you (or someone you can vouch for) ran this profile against
    real hardware and it worked end-to-end
  - `verified_mock` — validated against Oloo Studio's mock bus only, no real
    hardware confirmation yet
  - `planned` — stub only (`id`/`name`/`kind`/`dof`/`bus`/`support_status`/
    `lerobot_type`), no thumbnail required
- [ ] `README.md` has a **来源 / Source** section and a **许可 / License** section
      (not required for `planned` stubs)
- [ ] `thumbnail.webp` is present, ≤100 KB, ~512×512 (not required for `planned`
      stubs)
- [ ] If you added `urdf/`, it includes `NOTICE.md` documenting the upstream
      source, license, and any modification (decimation, unit conversion, etc.)
- [ ] You did **not** hand-edit `index.json` — it's generated by
      `python scripts/build_index.py --write`
